subject: Vendor onboarding: MSA redlines and Ariba supplier ID crosswalk
messages:
From: Elena Suarez <elena.suarez@varumed.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: procurement@varumed.com
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood onboarding + MSA redlines

Hi Rachel —

Thanks for the kickoff earlier. Procurement at VaruMed is starting supplier registration in Ariba and we need to attach an executed MSA + an order form template to complete our vendor onboarding. I’m attaching VaruMed’s onboarding checklist and our preferred PO header requirements (PO number, remit address, tax ID, contact for invoices).

Two asks to keep things moving:
- Can Redwood confirm whether you can accept our MSA redline section on data retention (we flagged 3.2 and 7.1) or propose alternate language?
- We’ll need a supplier ID and the preferred Ariba CSV mapping (we can accept either your remit/edi fields or an Ariba supplier ID).

Attached: onboarding_checklist.pdf (see notes), VaruMed_PO_requirements.xlsx.

Short turnaround on our side — can you reply with a plan by EOD tomorrow?

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Suarez
Director, Strategic Sourcing
VaruMed Health

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood-inference.com>
To: Elena Suarez <elena.suarez@varumed.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding + MSA redlines

Hi Elena —

Appreciate the checklist and the clear asks. Quick plan from our side:
1) I’ve looped in Karthik (integration) and Ben (account lead) to confirm Ariba/Supplier ID flow.
2) Marissa from Legal will review the specific redlines you flagged in 3.2 and 7.1; she’ll provide a short comment set.
3) We’ll return a redline + a proposed counter-offer on retention language and share an Ariba CSV with our preferred field mapping by EOD tomorrow.

Ben — can you confirm whether Redwood can provision a temporary supplier ID for VaruMed so you can proceed with PO tests? Karthik — see Elena’s attachment for PO header requirements; we may need a small crosswalk for EDI vs Ariba fields.

Rachel Kim
Senior Manager, GTM Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood-inference.com>, Elena Suarez <elena.suarez@varumed.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 12:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding + MSA redlines

Thanks Rachel / Elena —

We can provision a temporary supplier ID on our side and generate an Ariba CSV for VaruMed to upload. Two items I want to surface before we proceed:
- Legal: we’re sensitive to retention limits in 3.2; if VaruMed needs longer retention than our standard 13 months for diagnostic logs, we’ll need an exceptions workflow (Marissa, assigning to you).
- Billing: VaruMed’s remit address in the spreadsheet is different from the one we have on file for prior POs — Elena, can you confirm the remit name and tax ID we should accept on invoices?

I’ll attach the draft CSV template and a short checklist for PO acceptance once Marissa confirms redlines.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood-inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>, Elena Suarez <elena.suarez@varumed.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding + MSA redlines

Elena / team —

I reviewed VaruMed’s OrderForm_FieldSpec and sketched a crosswalk. Key notes:
- Ariba requires supplier_id, remit_name, remit_address_line1, remit_country, tax_id, invoice_contact_email. We can populate all fields from your sheet except invoice_contact_email (we need a single email).
- PO line item matching: we support both catalog and non-catalog POs; please standardize the PO number format (VaruMed-YYYY-#####) so our auto-ack parser can route to the right account.
- EDI/CSV: I’m attaching ariba_supplier_crosswalk.csv (sample) and a short script to validate the CSV.

If legal limits retention to 13 months, our KV caching and logs older than 13 months will be redacted automatically; if VaruMed needs 24 months we need a documented exception and SOC/archival controls.

Next steps: Elena confirm invoice contact email + remit/tax details; Marissa to confirm whether we can accept retention changes or offer a narrow carve-out for billing metadata.

Karthik Iyer
Integration Lead, Platform Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
To: Elena Suarez <elena.suarez@varumed.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 15:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding + MSA redlines

Hi Elena —

I reviewed the redlines in VaruMed_MSA_redlines_v3.docx. Short summary:
- Section 3.2 (Data retention): we can accept retention to 18 months for billing and invoice metadata only (remit/tax/invoice headers). We cannot make a platform-wide 24-month retention commitment for logs or model telemetry due to multi-tenant operational constraints.
- Section 7.1 (Audit & access): we will provide audit exports on a quarterly basis under an NDA + COPIA clause; on-demand exports are available but billed as professional services if they require ad-hoc extraction.

If VaruMed agrees to the limited 18-month retention carve-out (billing metadata only) and the audit export billing terms, we can sign the MSA with the updated language. I have attached a tracked-changes file and a 2-line clause you can paste into Ariba comments during registration.

Action items:
- Elena: confirm remit name + tax ID + preferred invoice contact email.
- Rachel/Ben: once Elena confirms, Karthik to upload ariba_supplier_crosswalk.csv and we’ll provision a temporary supplier ID for PO testing.

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Legal Operations
Redwood Inference
